A bold wrapper holding only a newline-only span still separates the words on either side

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<b>Alpha</b><b><span>\n</span></b><b>Beta</b>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
